summary: The week's heaviest signal is agents improving their own scaffolding: harness self-improvement papers from Google (RRSI) and NVIDIA (SoL-Pi) top the ledger, next to a distillation paper that folds harness gains back into the weights and an ontology layer that data agents revise as they work. Outside agents, video world models are pushing on 3D-consistent memory, geometry-native latents and playability. Robot papers argue for grounding (3D objects, action tokens, world-model features, a VLM command interface) over raw VLA scale.

title_candidates.title: Figure Review 001: The Harness Is the Model
title_candidates.why: top two papers and a harness-distillation paper all treat the scaffolding as the thing being trained

title_candidates.title: Figure Review 001: Harnesses, Worlds, and Robots
title_candidates.why: a plain roundup title that covers the three themes

themes.name: Harness self-improvement
themes.why: The prompts, tools, memory and control flow around a frozen model are now searched, regularized and distilled like weights, and the artifacts agents use (ontologies, skills) are revised from execution feedback. The 09.18 RSI stream, one week on.

papers.why: SoL-Pi: scales auto-research loops over many environments for token-efficient harness discovery
RRSI: constrains harness edit proposals so self-improvement gains survive out of distribution
Harness-Zero: distills harness-induced behavior into model weights so gains persist without the harness
EvoOntology: a self-evolving semantic layer between data agents and heterogeneous data

themes.name: World models with memory and geometry
themes.why: Video world models are adding 3D-aware memory, geometry-native latents and real-time control to stay consistent over long horizons.

papers.why: WorldCrafter: camera-queryable implicit 3D memory for long-horizon consistent video
GAE: a geometry-native latent space shared by perception and generation
JEPA-Anything: one predictive-factorization recipe across seven different world domains
Zing-0.5: 5B autoregressive playable world model with joint keyboard and text control

themes.name: Grounding robot policies
themes.why: Robot papers put explicit structure under the policy (3D grounding, action tokenizers, world-model features, VLM agent interfaces) instead of relying on end-to-end VLA scale.

papers.why: Grounded Action Models: 3D object grounding as the robot foundation
RoboDawn: exposes robot control to an agentic VLM through discrete commands
ActionPiece: action tokenization that preserves adjustments across demonstrations
distills world-model representations into a compact VLA
